components: A skewed key maps disproportionate traffic to one shard.
CPU, storage, or queue capacity saturates before the cluster.
Per-key and per-shard metrics expose concentration.
Salting, splitting, caching, or dedicated capacity spreads work.
Reads or aggregates recombine salted pieces when required.
